name: Log4Shell exploit succeeds on app02; attacker pivots after the block
description: Headline demo. app02 runs log4j-core 2.14.1 with no egress filtering. The JNDI payload triggers an outbound LDAP callback and java spawns a shell. Correct outcome: SUCCEEDED, block 203.0.113.66, propose isolation (needs approval). After the block the attacker returns from 198.51.100.23 with the same exploit; the verifier surfaces the new alert and the agent blocks the second IP too.
